name: Welcome & Leave
description: Greet new members, say goodbye, and hand out a starter role.

settings.label: Welcome channel
settings.description: Where welcome messages are posted.

settings.label: Welcome message
settings.description: Use {user} for the member and {server} for the server name.

settings.label: Send as embed
settings.description: Wrap the welcome message in a styled embed.

settings.label: Embed title
settings.description: Title of the welcome embed. Empty = no title.

settings.label: Embed colour
settings.description: Hex colour such as #2EE6B6. Empty = default.

settings.label: Embed image
settings.description: Large image shown in the welcome embed. Empty = no image.

settings.label: Welcome image card
settings.description: Design a picture with the member's avatar and name that is posted with the welcome. Leave it empty to turn it off.

settings.label: Leave channel
settings.description: Where goodbye messages are posted.

settings.label: Leave message
settings.description: Use {user} and {server}.

settings.label: Send as embed
settings.description: Wrap the goodbye message in a styled embed.

settings.label: Embed title
settings.description: Title of the goodbye embed. Empty = no title.

settings.label: Embed colour
settings.description: Hex colour such as #E0526B. Empty = default.

settings.label: Embed image
settings.description: Large image shown in the goodbye embed. Empty = no image.

settings.label: Goodbye image card
settings.description: Design a picture posted with the goodbye message. Leave it empty to turn it off.

settings.label: Auto role
settings.description: Role given to every new member.

name: Applications
description: Build application forms (staff, partners, anything), run them in DMs or on the website, and review them with Reply / Accept / Deny buttons.

settings.label: Application forms
settings.description: Each form has its own questions, limits and accept/deny messages. Run it in DMs or on the website, then add it to any ticket panel as an Apply button (Tickets page) or post it from here. Applications arrive in your Mod log channel with Reply / Accept / Deny buttons.

settings.label: Applications open
settings.description: Turn staff applications on or off.

settings.label: Review channel
settings.description: Where new applications arrive for staff.

settings.label: Apply panel channel
settings.description: Where the apply button is posted.

settings.label: Role given when accepted
settings.description: Given to people whose application is accepted.

name: Logs & Reports
description: Where moderation actions and member reports are sent.

settings.label: Mod log channel
settings.description: Bans, kicks, timeouts, warnings and other actions are logged here.

settings.label: Report channel
settings.description: Where /report submissions arrive for staff.

name: Tickets
description: Private support tickets for your members.

settings.label: Ticket category
settings.description: New tickets are created inside this category.

settings.label: Panel title
settings.description: Title shown on the ticket panel (applies to panels you post from now on).

settings.label: Panel description
settings.description: Text shown on the ticket panel.
settings.default: Click a button below to create a private ticket.

settings.label: Panel colour
settings.description: Hex colour of the ticket panel, such as #5865F2. Empty = default.

settings.label: Ticket types
settings.description: Up to 5 buttons on one panel. Each button can open a form, open a ticket straight away, run the ticket in DMs, open a link, or start an application (in DMs or on the website), with its own category and staff role. Post the panel with /ticket (Post Ticket Panel or Quick Setup).

settings.label: More ticket panels
settings.description: Extra panels you can post in other channels. Free: 1 extra panel with a single button (2 panels in total). Premium: up to 4 extra panels (5 in total) with up to 5 buttons each. Ultra: unlimited. Post any panel from the Dashboard (Post a panel) or with /ticket.

settings.label: DM the ticket owner when it closes
settings.description: Rex sends the person a DM when staff close their ticket or appeal.

settings.label: Ticket welcome message
settings.description: First message in every new ticket. Use {user}.
settings.default: Welcome {user}! Tell us how we can help.

name: Ban Appeals
description: Control how people banned by Rex in this server can appeal.

settings.label: Allow ban appeals
settings.description: Banned members get an Appeal button in their DM.

settings.label: Appeal category
settings.description: Appeal tickets are created in this category of YOUR server. Empty = the ticket category.

settings.label: Appeal staff role
settings.description: Who can see and answer appeals. Empty = the ticket staff role.

settings.label: Appeals per person
settings.description: How many appeal tickets one person may open for a ban from this server. 0 = unlimited.

settings.label: Hours between appeals
settings.description: Minimum wait before the same person can appeal again. 0 = no wait.

name: Custom Commands
description: Build your own slash commands from blocks: messages, embeds, roles, channels, forms, tickets and more.

settings.label: Your commands
settings.description: Custom slash commands for this server. Premium: 5. Ultra and Priority: unlimited.

name: Events
description: Run blocks automatically when someone joins, leaves, gets banned, opens a ticket, changes a setting, or on a timer.

settings.label: Your events
settings.description: Automations for this server. Premium: 5. Ultra and Priority: unlimited.

name: Levels & XP
description: Rewards for chatting and talking in voice.

settings.label: Levels enabled
settings.description: Turn the whole level system on or off.

settings.label: Level-up channel
settings.description: Where level-up messages go. Empty = the channel the member is chatting in.

settings.label: XP per message
settings.description: How much XP each message earns.

settings.label: XP per level
settings.description: XP needed for each level.

settings.label: Message XP cooldown (seconds)
settings.description: Minimum seconds between XP gains. 0 = none.

settings.label: Voice XP per interval
settings.description: XP for time spent in voice. 0 turns voice XP off.

settings.label: Level rewards
settings.description: Give a role when someone reaches a level.

settings.label: Voice XP interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often voice XP is given while someone is in a voice channel.

name: Community & Games
description: Economy, games and the counting channel.

settings.label: Economy enabled
settings.description: Coins, daily rewards and work.

settings.label: Games enabled
settings.description: Rex games that earn coins.

settings.label: Auto-publish channels
settings.description: Announcement channels where Rex publishes every message so followers get it.

settings.label: Counting channel
settings.description: Members count upwards together. Changing the channel restarts the count at 0.

name: Verification
description: Role given to members who verify. Pick the role and channel, then publish the verify panel from here.

settings.label: Verification channel
settings.description: Where the verify panel is posted.

settings.label: Verified role
settings.description: Given when a member completes verification.

settings.label: Roblox verification channel
settings.description: Where the Roblox verify panel is posted.

settings.label: Roblox verified role
settings.description: Given when a member links Roblox (Premium).

name: Protection & AutoMod
description: Spam, link, swear and alt-account protection.

settings.label: Anti-spam
settings.description: Acts on 5 messages in 5 seconds or 3 identical messages.

settings.label: Anti-link
settings.description: Removes links from regular members.

settings.label: Allowed domains
settings.description: Domains that are still allowed. Separate with commas, e.g. youtube.com, discord.com

settings.label: Anti-swear
settings.description: Removes messages containing blocked words.

settings.label: AutoMod
settings.description: Rex's automatic moderation.

settings.label: Extra blocked words
settings.description: Added to Rex's built-in list. Separate with commas.

settings.label: Anti-ping on
settings.description: Turn all anti-ping protection on or off without losing your list.

settings.label: Anti-ping protected user
settings.description: Pings of this member are blocked. Paste their Discord user ID, or leave empty.

settings.label: Anti-ping protected roles
settings.description: Members with these roles are protected from being pinged. Pick as many as you need.

settings.label: Message shown to the sender
settings.description: Shown by Discord when a message is blocked. Empty = default.

settings.label: Timeout for pingers (minutes)
settings.description: Time out whoever pings a protected member. 0 = just block.

settings.label: Use Discord AutoMod
settings.description: Rex builds real Discord AutoMod rules for anti-ping, blocked words, links and swearing, so blocked messages never appear to anyone.

settings.label: Anti-alt
settings.description: Reports very new accounts when they join.

settings.label: Anti-alt alert channel
settings.description: Where young accounts are reported.

settings.label: Stop new bots on join
settings.description: Part of the anti-raid system. When a bot joins, Rex strips its roles and permissions and asks a moderator to Allow (give everything back) or Remove (kick) it. Off by default.

settings.label: Approval channel
settings.description: Where the Allow / Remove request is posted. Empty = your Mod log channel.

settings.label: Role that can approve bots
settings.description: People with this role can press Allow / Remove. Moderators, admins and the owner always can.

settings.label: Person who can approve bots
settings.description: Discord user ID of one extra person who can approve or remove bots.

settings.label: Honeypot channel
settings.description: A channel normal members should never talk in.

settings.label: Honeypot action
settings.description: What happens to anyone who posts in the honeypot.

name: Staff Roles
description: Which roles Rex treats as staff.

settings.label: Analytics channel
settings.description: Where Rex sends analytics and activity reports.

name: Priority
description: Case management, raid and spam preferences for Priority servers.

settings.label: Raid join threshold
settings.description: Joins that count as a raid.

settings.label: New account age (days)
settings.description: Accounts younger than this are flagged.

settings.label: Spam response
settings.description: Preferred response to spam.

settings.label: Appeal instructions
settings.description: Shown to banned members who ask how to appeal. Empty = default text.

name: Security
description: Raid alerts, deep logging and optional automatic enforcement.

settings.label: Appeal prompt
settings.description: What people are asked when they appeal a moderation action. Empty = default.

settings.label: Alert channel
settings.description: Ultra alerts go here. Empty = your mod log channel.

settings.label: Join-burst alerts
settings.description: Alert when many members join quickly.

settings.label: Burst size (joins)
settings.description: Joins that trigger an alert.

settings.label: Burst window (seconds)
settings.description: Time window for the burst.

settings.label: New-account alerts
settings.description: Alert when very new accounts join.

settings.label: New-account cutoff (days)
settings.description: Accounts younger than this are flagged.

settings.label: Mention-flood alerts
settings.description: Alert on mass mentions.

settings.label: Invite-link alerts
settings.description: Alert when invite links are posted.

settings.label: Repeated-message alerts
settings.description: Alert on copy-paste spam.

settings.label: Channel-deletion alerts
settings.description: Alert when channels are deleted.

settings.label: Role-deletion alerts
settings.description: Alert when roles are deleted.

settings.label: Log message edits
settings.description: Keep a log of edited messages.

settings.label: Log message deletions
settings.description: Keep a log of deleted messages.

settings.label: Delete invite links
settings.description: Automatically remove invite links.

settings.label: Delete mass-mention messages
settings.description: Automatically remove mention floods.

settings.label: Delete repeated spam
settings.description: Automatically remove repeated messages.

settings.label: Timeout mention flooders
settings.description: Time out members who flood mentions.

settings.label: Timeout repeat spammers
settings.description: Time out members who repeat messages.

settings.label: Timeout length
settings.description: How long automatic timeouts last.

name: Bot Branding
description: Change how Rex looks in this server only: its name, picture, banner and bio, and the colour of its embeds.

settings.label: Embed colour
settings.description: Replaces Rex's default blue on its embeds in this server. Example #E0526B. Empty = default.

settings.label: Bot name
settings.description: Rex's display name in this server. Empty = default.

settings.label: Bot picture
settings.description: Upload a picture or paste a link. Shown as Rex's avatar in this server only.

settings.label: Bot banner
settings.description: Wide image on Rex's profile card in this server.

settings.label: Bot bio
settings.description: The About me text on Rex's profile in this server (190 characters).

settings.label: Footer text
settings.description: Shown in the footer of Ultra panels and logs.

settings.label: Embed image
settings.description: Image used in Ultra embeds. Upload one or paste a link.
